title: Roof Surfacing Losses: HomeGuard Claims Manual Section
content:
Roof surfacing is the one part of a HomeGuard Homeowners Policy dwelling claim whose settlement turns on the age and material of the roof. This section of the claims manual sets out how roof surfacing damage from wind or hail is classified and paid.

## Classification and roof age

Roof surfacing damage from wind or hail on the dwelling is paid with the property class **roof surfacing**. Its roof age is the calendar year of the date of loss less the roof install year on the declarations, recorded on the payment as the roof age in whole years.

*Hypothetical example.* A roof installed in 2009 that is damaged by hail on any day of 2024 has a roof age of 15 years: 2024 less 2009. The month of installation and the month of loss do not enter the figure.

## Settlement by roof settlement basis

- **Replacement cost basis.** When the policy's roof settlement basis is replacement cost, roof surfacing settles like the rest of the dwelling under the HomeGuard loss settlement conditions.
- **Roof surfacing schedule basis — clause no longer in force.** The following clause is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current settlement basis: "When the roof settlement basis is the roof surfacing schedule, roof surfacing is paid once as a roof schedule payment: the replacement-cost value multiplied by the roof payment schedule percentage for the roof age band, less the deductible it absorbs; nothing is withheld and no depreciation is ever recoverable on it, while the rest of the dwelling damage still settles under the loss settlement conditions."

## Roof payment schedule

The HomeGuard roof payment schedule sets a percentage for each roof age band:

| Roof age band (years) | Schedule percentage |
|---|---|
| 0 to 10 | 100 |
| 11 to 12 | 85 |
| 13 to 14 | 75 |
| 15 to 16 | 65 |
| 17 to 18 | 55 |
| 19 to 20 | 45 |
| 21 to 24 | 35 |
| 25 and over | 25 |

*Reading the bands (hypothetical ages).* A roof aged 10 years sits in the 0 to 10 band at 100 percent; one aged 11 years sits in the 11 to 12 band at 85 percent. A roof aged 24 years sits at 35 percent and one aged 25 years at 25 percent.

## Exclusions specific to roofs

- **Cosmetic hail to metal roofs.** On a package whose cosmetic roof hail exclusion applies, hail dents to a metal roof that do not let water in are denied as cosmetic damage. On the other packages such dents are paid.
- **Wear and tear.** Wear, tear and deterioration of a roof is never covered and is denied as wear and tear.

## When the roof settlement basis changes

The policy's roof settlement basis changes only at binding, at renewal and after a documented roof replacement. It never changes because of a claim.
